goal_objective: Advance fix/research-runner-oom-victim: The research-runner service survives aggregate memory pressure from other processes in its container: the kernel OOM-kills those processes, never the service, so the concurrent-memory probe passes reliably.. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Root cause of the intermittent concurrent-memory failure is reproduced and explained in the handoff.; AC2: The unmodified probe passes repeatedly against the fixed image in the configuration that failed deterministically before (no swap headroom), and the sandbox probe still denies every escape.; AC3: Unit tests cover the sweep (siblings raised, service untouched, vanished/foreign processes tolerated) and the in-job sweep; the research-runner unit and deployment tests pass.; AC4: Exact-source feature CI and the staging exhaustive gate (which runs the live research-runner probe stage) are green; production deployment waits for the human's approval.. Required local profile: full_stack_browser. Stop at ready_for_human_review; do not integrate, promote, deploy, or modify another worktree.
